parentId.reads: The block's `data-parent-id`: the name of the layout block (a container, accordion or tabs, or an item of one) it is moved into. A block with no `parentId` stays where it is.

titleType.reads: The heading level of a Teaser-family title. A `title` field with a `titleType` field beside it arrives as one cell holding an `<h1>` to `<h5>` element, and no `titleType` row. The reader takes the level from that element's tag into the content prop `titleTag`; a cell with no heading keeps any `titleType` row it was given. The Title block takes its level as the option list `headingTag` instead (h2 when none is chosen).
